quote: When an ordinary conversation changes instructions, releasing its subscription can start native asynchronous shutdown; thread/resume then returns the pinned Codex implementation's 'thread is closing' RPC error.
note: The earlier P1 item “Await teardown for healthy threads before resuming” warned that a configuration refresh could resume during native teardown and fall back to a fresh thread without the conversation history. The merge-time review marked the finding resolved, but the race shipped.
